title: LRU cache with LinkedHashMap access order
contract: Fixed capacity; get and put both count as uses and the least recently used key is evicted when a put would exceed capacity. Re-putting replaces the value and promotes the key. keys() lists least-recently-used first. A miss does not promote. Capacity below 1 throws IllegalArgumentException.
notShownInJavadoc: get promotes so a different key is evicted
eviction order without a promoting get
re-put promotes as well as replaces
